ns2:section.sectionText: First class meeting is Sep 7; last class/national certification exam is October 19. Registration is restricted to Hospitality Management and Dietetic majors until after junior registration, and then remaining seats open to Human Nutrition and Food Industry and Business majors; after freshman registration, any remaining seats will be open to all majors. FSHN minors must contact the department office for registration authorization (333-1324). TO BE ADDED TO A WAIT LIST FOR THIS CLASS, go to www.fshn.uiuc.edu and click on "Info for Current Students" and then on "Waitlist Information."
